nested_loso: for each temporal fold remove held-out station from training, refit standardization and global MAP, predict only held-out station evaluation rows
nested_loto: for each temporal fold remove all stations in held-out terminal tree, refit and predict held-out tree evaluation rows
station_blind_benchmark: equal-weight mean of training-station mean logQ
spatial_support: bootstrap CI95 lower skill > 0 for both LOSO and LOTO
temporal_mainline_policy: spatial failure narrows claim but is not an upgrade veto
water_accounting: fixed monthly retention across month lengths
forbidden: calling process fast/slow proxies observed water age
